subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw own a bundled first-party Claude app-server runtime, or should this capability remain an external ClawHub plugin built on generic extension seams?
rationale: The answer determines who owns executable dependencies, OAuth/session material, persistent bindings, configuration compatibility, and the public runtime contract; those choices cannot be safely inferred from the patch alone.

options.title: Sponsor a focused replacement
options.body: Accept the capability in principle but rebuild it around first-party package ownership, SQLite state, plugin-declared authentication, sanitized spawning, and public SDK contracts.

options.title: Externalize to ClawHub
options.body: Keep the bridge as a third-party plugin and add only genuinely missing generic plugin APIs to core.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Close or pause this branch until the canonical issue establishes a supported product and security direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a focused replacement
recommendation.body: Accept the capability in principle but rebuild it around first-party package ownership, SQLite state, plugin-declared authentication, sanitized spawning, and public SDK contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent runtime-policy work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the bundled-versus-external product choice.
